item.text:
# Putin (RUS), 2023 reconnaissance notebook

Input priors: `419` local fact rows, `80` methodology rows, `60` evidence_found, `20` no_evidence_found. No scores assigned.

## Authority Baseline

- Formal office baseline: the Kremlin describes the President of Russia as head of state, guarantor of the constitution and human/civil rights, with authority over domestic and foreign policy and as commander-in-chief. [Kremlin structure page](https://en.kremlin.ru/structure/president)
- Incumbency baseline: Putin’s official Kremlin bio shows him as president since 2012, with prior presidential and de facto leadership periods. [Kremlin biography](https://en.kremlin.ru/catalog/persons/54/biography)
- Regime baseline: Freedom House says power is concentrated in Putin’s hands, with subservient courts, controlled media, pliable opposition, and no democratic transfer of power. [Freedom House Russia 2024](https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024)
- Domestic legitimacy baseline: Kremlin-adjacent pollsters reported Putin trust in the high 70s during late 2023, but this should be treated as a regime-conditioned indicator rather than neutral public sentiment. [VCIOM, 22 Dec 2023](https://wciom.ru/analytical-reviews/analiticheskii-obzor/reitingi-doverija-politikam-ocenki-raboty-prezidenta-i-pravitelstva-podderzhka-politicheskikh-partii-22122023)

## Major Inherited Conditions Entering 2023

- The full-scale war in Ukraine was already underway, with sanctions, battlefield attrition, and deep diplomatic isolation shaping every 2023 judgment. [Freedom House key developments](https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024)
- Civil liberties were already heavily compressed: opposition channels were constrained, courts were not independent, and the media environment was controlled. [Freedom House overview](https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024)
- Corruption and property-rights insecurity were long-standing structural features, not 2023 novelties. [Transparency International Russia](https://ti-russia.org/en/corruption-perceptions-index/cpi-2023/)
- War mobilization had already begun to distort labor markets, budgets, and industrial allocation before 2023 ended. [Reuters on labor shortage](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/russian-labour-shortage-laid-bare-as-unemployment-drops-to-record-low-3095351)
- Official information access was degraded by wartime secrecy and state opacity, which affects confidence in any internal metrics. [Freedom House](https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024)

## 2023 Event Reconnaissance

| Date | Evidence | Why it matters | Temporal fit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2023-02-21 | Putin’s Federal Assembly address is listed on the Kremlin transcript index. [Kremlin transcript index](https://en.kremlin.ru/events/president/transcripts/messages) | Baseline for war framing, domestic priorities, and escalation posture. | Direct 2023 event |
| 2023-02-20 / 2023-02-21 | Reuters reported Putin suspended New START and issued renewed nuclear warnings to the West. [Reuters via Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/putin-to-update-russias-elite-on-ukraine-war-in-major-speech-3008359) | Strong nuclear-coercion signal and foreign-policy hardening. | Direct 2023 event |
| 2023-03-17 | ICC issued an arrest warrant for Putin over the unlawful deportation of Ukrainian children. [Reuters via Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/icc-judges-issue-arrest-warrant-against-putin-over-alleged-war-crimes-3033607) | Major legitimacy and international-law shock. | Direct 2023 event |
| 2023-03-25 / 2023-06-16 | Putin said Russia would station tactical nuclear weapons in Belarus; later confirmed they had been delivered. [Reuters via RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-belarus-tactical-nuclear/32334137.html) and [Reuters via Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/putin-says-russia-positions-nuclear-bombs-in-belarus-as-warning-to-west-3107500) | Direct nuclear-signaling evidence for later strategic-deterrence review. | Direct 2023 event |
| 2023-04-25 / 2023-04-26 | Putin signed a decree taking temporary control of Fortum and Uniper-linked Russian assets; Reuters said the move could expand. [Reuters via Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/putin-signs-decree-taking-over-russian-assets-of-two-foreign-firms-3064283) | Property-rights, state capture, and retaliation against sanctions. | Direct 2023 event |
| 2023-05-15 / 2023-05-31 / 2023-08-30 | Reuters reported defence spending up 282% y/y in Jan-Feb, unemployment at record lows, and labour shortages squeezing growth. [Reuters via Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/russias-defence-spending-jumped-282-yy-to-26-billion-in-janfeb-budget-data-3082745), [Reuters via Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/russian-labour-shortage-laid-bare-as-unemployment-drops-to-record-low-3095351), [Reuters via Investing](https://m.investing.com/news/economy/russian-jobless-rate-hits-new-record-low-in-strained-labour-market-3164576?ampMode=1) | Mixed evidence: war economy strength, but rising strain and bottlenecks. | Direct 2023 event |
| 2023-06-24 to 2023-06-27 | Wagner mutiny and Putin’s “treason” / law-and-order response. [Freedom House](https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024) and [Kremlin event index](https://en.kremlin.ru/events/president/transcripts/statements/page/2) | Elite cohesion, coercive control, and regime stress test. | Direct 2023 event |
| 2023-07-12 / 2023-03-21 | Memorial-related searches and Oleg Orlov prosecution, per UN experts. [UN Special Rapporteurs](https://srdefenders.org/russia-search-of-the-homes-offices-of-members-of-the-ngo-memorial-and-criminalisation-of-oleg-orlov-joint-communication/) | Repression of civil society and historical memory institutions. | Direct 2023 event |
| 2023-08-04 | Navalny was sentenced to 19 years in a harsh prison regime on extremism charges. [RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-navalny-sentenced-19-years-/32534422.html) | Core repression indicator. | Direct 2023 event |
| 2023-08-24 | Prigozhin’s presumed death in a plane crash removed a major internal challenger. [Reuters via Investing](https://uk.investing.com/news/commodities-news/analysispresumed-death-of-prigozhin-removes-one-problem-may-create-new-ones-for-putin-3133951) | Elite discipline improved, but with unresolved succession/loyalty risk. | Direct 2023 event |
| 2023-11-30 | Russia’s Supreme Court banned the “LGBT movement” as extremist. [Reuters via Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russias-supreme-court-bans-lgbt-movement-as-extremist-3246937) and [HRW](https://www.hrw.org/news/2023/11/30/russia-supreme-court-bans-lgbt-movement-extremist) | Civil liberties, social control, and ideological mobilization. | Direct 2023 event |
| 2023-12-14 / 2023-12-22 | Putin’s year-end event emphasized inflation control; VCIOM reported high trust. [Reuters via Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/putin-russian-inflation-could-near-8-this-year-3256747), [VCIOM](https://wciom.ru/analytical-reviews/analiticheskii-obzor/reitingi-doverija-politikam-ocenki-raboty-prezidenta-i-pravitelstva-podderzhka-politicheskikh-partii-22122023) | Useful for domestic narrative, but needs bias-aware treatment. | Direct 2023 event |

## Favorable Evidence

- The Russian economy was more resilient than many expected. The IMF says GDP grew `3.6%` in 2023. [IMF April 2024 WEO briefing](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/04/16/tr041624-transcript-of-april-2024-weo-press-briefing)
- The World Bank also described 2023 regional growth as stronger than expected, with Russia and Ukraine returning to growth. [World Bank Europe and Central Asia update](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/04/11/sluggish-growth-delaying-economic-recovery-in-emerging-europe-and-central-asia)
- Russia’s official Accounts Chamber said 2023 GDP grew `3.6%`, industrial production rose, and investment hit a record pace. [Kremlin meeting with Accounts Chamber chairman, 23 Jul 2024](https://en.kremlin.ru/events/president/transcripts/copy/74625)
- Reuters reported a tight labour market, strong real-wage gains, and low unemployment, which indicates wartime mobilization did not collapse the labor system. [Reuters via Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/russian-jobless-rate-hits-new-record-low-in-strained-labour-market-3164576?ampMode=1)
- The state kept fiscal and military priorities funded. Reuters reported the 2023 budget came in around `32.2 trillion rubles` and defence spending was extremely elevated. [Reuters via Investing](https://m.uk.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/russian-budget-expenditure-in-2023-to-total-351-billion--finance-minister-3281612?ampMode=1)
- Official polling still showed strong trust and approval for Putin in late 2023. [VCIOM](https://wciom.ru/analytical-reviews/analiticheskii-obzor/reitingi-doverija-politikam-ocenki-raboty-prezidenta-i-pravitelstva-podderzhka-politicheskikh-partii-22122023)

## Adverse Evidence

- International legal and reputational pressure intensified sharply with the ICC warrant. [Reuters](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/icc-judges-issue-arrest-warrant-against-putin-over-alleged-war-crimes-3033607)
- Wagner’s June rebellion exposed elite and coercive fragility. [Freedom House](https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024)
- Navalny’s 19-year sentence and Memorial-related repression show continued systematic anti-opposition enforcement. [RFE/RL Navalny](https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-navalny-sentenced-19-years-/32534422.html), [UN experts on Memorial/Orlov](https://srdefenders.org/russia-search-of-the-homes-offices-of-members-of-the-ngo-memorial-and-criminalisation-of-oleg-orlov-joint-communication/)
- The LGBT extremism ruling signaled further narrowing of civil space and social pluralism. [HRW](https://www.hrw.org/news/2023/11/30/russia-supreme-court-bans-lgbt-movement-extremist)
- Corruption remained severe: Russia scored `26/100` in TI’s 2023 CPI and ranked `141/180`. [Transparency International Russia](https://ti-russia.org/en/corruption-perceptions-index/cpi-2023/)
- Property rights weakened further as the state expanded external management and seizures of foreign-linked assets. [Reuters via Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/factboxmoscow-takes-control-over-assets-of-western-companies-3136331)
- Economic stress was real underneath the headline growth: labour shortages, inflation pressure, and high defence spending all worsened. [Reuters labour shortage](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/russian-labour-shortage-laid-bare-as-unemployment-drops-to-record-low-3095351), [Reuters inflation](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/putin-russian-inflation-could-near-8-this-year-3256747)

## Candidate Chapter Links

Working lens labels below are for later chapter research routing, not scores.

1. `Authority / selection / elite control`
- Best anchors: Kremlin structure, Freedom House, VCIOM, Putin biography.
- Why inspect: formal office concentration, no real transfer of power, high but constrained approval.

2. `Civil liberties / repression / media / association`
- Best anchors: Freedom House, HRW, State Department, UN special procedures, Memorial/Orlov cases, LGBT ruling.
- Why inspect: direct evidence of escalating repression in 2023.

3. `Corruption / rule of law / property rights`
- Best anchors: Transparency International, Reuters asset seizures, World Bank governance materials.
- Why inspect: corruption remains entrenched and state predation on assets intensified.

4. `Economic management / state capacity`
- Best anchors: IMF, World Bank, Reuters labour/budget reporting, Kremlin economic speeches.
- Why inspect: growth was real, but war-economy distortions and inflation risks also rose.

5. `Domestic stability / coercive control`
- Best anchors: Wagner mutiny coverage, Memorial raids, Navalny sentencing, state security response.
- Why inspect: 2023 had a real internal stress test, not just routine repression.

6. `War / foreign policy / conflict conduct`
- Best anchors: Freedom House, Reuters chronology, Kremlin speeches, UCDP/ACLED later.
- Why inspect: Ukraine war dominated the year and spilled into Russia itself.

7. `Nuclear signalling / strategic coercion`
- Best anchors: Reuters on New START suspension and Belarus tactical nukes, Kremlin transcripts, SIPRI.
- Why inspect: nuclear rhetoric was unusually explicit in 2023.

8. `Social order / identity / ideological control`
- Best anchors: LGBT extremism ruling, HRW, State Department, Russian legal changes.
- Why inspect: the regime used moral conservatism and social policing as a control lever.

## Source Landscape For Follow-On Chapter Research

- `Official Kremlin`: formal authority, speeches, decrees, budget and policy framing. [Kremlin event index](https://en.kremlin.ru/events/president/transcripts/statements)
- `Independent human-rights monitors`: repression, association, and civil liberties. [Freedom House](https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024), [HRW](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/russia), [UN experts](https://srdefenders.org/russia-search-of-the-homes-offices-of-members-of-the-ngo-memorial-and-criminalisation-of-oleg-orlov-joint-communication/)
- `Macro / capacity`: IMF, World Bank, Russian official budget data, Reuters economy coverage. [IMF](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/04/16/tr041624-transcript-of-april-2024-weo-press-briefing), [World Bank](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/04/11/sluggish-growth-delaying-economic-recovery-in-emerging-europe-and-central-asia)
- `Corruption / rule of law`: TI CPI, Reuters on asset seizures, World Bank governance references. [TI Russia CPI 2023](https://ti-russia.org/en/corruption-perceptions-index/cpi-2023/)
- `War / conflict`: Reuters chronology, later ACLED/UCDP, ISW-style operational updates.
- `Nuclear`: Reuters + SIPRI + Kremlin transcripts.
- `Public opinion`: FOM, VCIOM, Levada, with bias caveats.

## Temporal Fit Notes

- `Direct 2023 event`: happened inside the target year and is safe as primary reconnaissance evidence.
- `2024 retrospective on 2023`: useful for aggregation, but should be treated as a later synthesis, not a contemporaneous fact.
- `Stable baseline`: formal role descriptions, long-running regime properties, and persistent institutions can anchor the year without overfitting to a single month.

If you want, I can turn this into a reusable dossier template keyed to the project’s evidence IDs and chapter workflow.
